name: EMMA
intro: EMMA（Enhanced MultiModal reAsoning）是一个旨在评估多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）有机多模态推理能力的基准测试。它涵盖数学、物理、化学和编程等领域，任务需要跨模态推理，不能仅通过单一模态独立解决。对现有MLLMs的评估显示，在处理复杂多模态和多步推理任务方面存在显著局限性，突显了改进多模态架构和训练范式的必要性。
org: University of Electronic Science and Technology of China, Sun Yat-sen University, University of Wash
intro_en: EMMA (Enhanced MultiModal reAsoning) is a benchmark designed to evaluate the organic multimodal reasoning abilities of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). It covers fields such as mathematics, physics, chemistry, and programming, requiring cross-modal reasoning that cannot be solved by a single modality alone. Evaluations of existing MLLMs reveal significant limitations in handling complex multimodal and multi-step reasoning tasks, highlighting the need to improve multimodal architectures and training paradigms.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2501.05444. EMMA targets organic multimodal reasoning across math, physics, chemistry, and coding. The benchmark is composed of 2,788 problems: 992 gathered from existing benchmarks through a rigorous filtering pipeline and 1,796 newly constructed questions. The paper captions images and combines captions with original text to query MLLMs; if models can answer a candidate under this text-only condition across repeated attempts, the item is filtered out. The authors then build subject-specific skill taxonomies, manually inspect retained questions, construct additional tasks, and assign skill labels. Evaluation covers multiple-choice and open-ended questions to measure whether MLLMs can integrate visual and textual reasoning rather than solve tasks with text-only cues.
